name: San Fernando de Henares (Spain)
description: Red field crossed diagonally from the upper hoist to the lower fly by a blue wavy stripe edged white, charged at the centre with the crowned municipal arms of San Fernando de Henares (a building on green with the letters F.VI).
history: The flag of San Fernando de Henares, approved on 5 June 1997 and published in the Boletín Oficial del Estado on 7 November 1997, is of proportions 2:3, a red cloth crossed diagonally from the upper hoist corner to the lower fly by a blue wavy stripe of 1/8 of the height of the cloth, with the crowned municipal arms superimposed at the centre.

features.role: wavy diagonal stripe edged white from the upper hoist to the lower fly
